identity: An Arabic driving-theory / traffic-law licence exam question bank (motorcycles and bicycles, public-transport buses, hazardous-materials transport, road markings, roundabouts, first aid). Twenty multiple-choice items, exactly one per <NL> line, 518 tokens. Punctuation AND the option letters have been stripped, so each item now appears as a stem immediately followed by its answer choices run together on a single line. Two of the twenty are true/false items (choices صحيح / خاطيء). This is doctrine register S/J: a quiz-worksheet, layout-driven, NOT running prose — none of the prose laws about connectives apply here, because there is almost no connective prose to judge.
law: The unit is the LAYOUT SLOT, not the sentence: [stem] || [choice] || [choice] || ... , one item per <NL>. (1) The stem swallows everything up to the first choice — every relative clause, every مثل-example, every و-coordination, and every dangling particle the writer left hanging before the colon (هو / قد / عن / ل / عليك / عند / من قبل / تقدر). My documented failure mode in this register is cutting INSIDE stems, so the stem boundary is pushed as late as the choice-frame allows. (2) Each answer choice is exactly one segment however short (الأنفاق, one token) or long (18 tokens in item 6), even when it contains و. (3) Nothing inside a choice is ever cut: و-lists (الريح والرمال والأمطار والحشرات), مثل-examples (مثل الذبحة الصدرية وتوقف القلب), asyndetic sub-lists (الإغماء الغيبوبة الصدمة), and numbers (6 سنوات, 50 كم) all weld. (4) Choices are located by their SHARED SYNTACTIC FRAME — the head that repeats across the alternatives: تفقد معدات دراجاتهم X3, إخبار/البقاء/محاولة/طمأنة (all maṣdar), استعمال/استعمال, رمز/رقم/اسم, ان يستعمل/ان يضايق/أن يستعمل, تغير تدريجي/تغير مفاجئ/تغير مفاجئ, بثلاثة/بخمسة/بسبعة/بعشرة أضعاف, عشرة/عشرون/ثلاثون/اربعون/خمسون. Wherever that frame restarts, the previous choice ended. (5) The meta-choice (جميع ما ذكر / لا شيء مما ذكر / أي من هذه) is always its own segment; it usually closes the list but in this bank the choices are shuffled, so it also turns up in position 2 or 3. The dominant template is four choices per item. (6) Every token immediately before an <NL> ends a segment, and so does the final token; the <NL> itself never does.
reasoning: TOKENISATION FIRST: 518 tokens, 0-517; nineteen <NL> at 24,44,64,86,106,153,173,198,222,267,292,317,344,369,394,421,438,465,491 — hence twenty items — and a final token 517 اليسار. The twenty forced boundaries (23,43,63,85,105,152,172,197,221,266,291,316,343,368,393,420,437,464,490,517) are free and taken. || ITEM 1, where does the stem stop? The choices are تفقد معدات دراجاتهم قبل بداية كل رحلة / [ت]فقد معدات دراجاتهم بشكل اسبوعي / تفقد معدات دراجاتهم بشكل شهري / لا شيء مما ذكر. Choices 2 and 3 REPEAT معدات دراجاتهم, so that phrase cannot be in the stem; the stem is the three-token fragment على سائقي الدراجات and cut@2 is safe despite its shortness. A three-token stem is not an anomaly — my doctrine's own gold in this register ends a stem at the bare copula هو. || ITEM 10 confirms it literally: الانحراف هو || ... — the same shape as the recorded gold '... علوم اللغة العربية هو ||'. Cut@224. Its three real choices are marked by the frame تغير تدريجي / تغير مفاجئ / تغير مفاجئ, and the ومن الممكن ان يكون ... او ... tails weld inside each. The stray one-word صحيح at 266 sits after لاشيء مماذكر; the two cannot be one choice (none-of-the-above vs. correct), and 266 is pre-<NL> anyway, so I cut@265 at medium — this looks like an answer-key remnant, and a bare one-word layout slot is its own segment by doctrine. || ITEM 12 is the hardest site. Chunks: أن هذه المركبة قد تنعطف يسارا فجأة / تشغل إشارات التحذير / تخفف سرعتها تدريجيا. Choices 2 and 3 are bare 3rd-fem-sg imperfects, and سرعتها proves their subject is المركبة, not the reader — so they are grammatically continuations of أن هذه المركبة قد. Two readings: stem ends at الانتباه@303 with a full first choice and two elliptical ones, or the shared prefix أن هذه المركبة قد sits in the stem and all three choices are parallel bare verbs. Test banks do not write one choice in full and abbreviate the rest; the ellipsis is only explained if the prefix is shared, i.e. printed once above the list. I take cut@307 (a stem ending on the particle قد) at medium, and note it also obeys my late-stem rule. || ITEM 14 has the same shape: the token ل stands ALONE (348) rather than prefixed to تدل, which only happens when the source printed توجد الخطوط الصفراء لـ and then broke to the choice list. Its four chunks look mismatched (تدل على وجوب تغيير المسار / حركة السير المتوجهة بالإتجاه المعاكس / تدل على وجود مناطق إنشاءات / حركة السير المتوجهة بالاتجاه ذاته) but they are a coherent shuffled four-option item — yellow lines separate opposing traffic, so choice 2 is the key and the other three are distractors of two different shapes. Four cuts, stem cut@348 at medium. || ITEM 9 vs ITEM 18, the two list-vs-choices sites, and I decided them oppositely. Item 9: مناطق الجسور عند عبورها / الأنفاق / التقاطعات المكشوفة / جميع ماذكر — three distinct hazard LOCATIONS answering 'from which areas...', plus all-of-the-above, giving the bank's dominant four-choice template. I cut@217, marked medium because الأنفاق التقاطعات المكشوفة could be one asyndetic choice; note 216, 219 and 221 hold under either reading. Item 18: إصابات الجهاز التنفسي مثل الإختناق وفشل التنفس / الإغماء الغيبوبة الصدمة / إصابات القلب مثل الذبحة الصدرية وتوقف القلب / جميع ما ذكر. Here I do NOT cut at 452/453: fainting-coma-shock is one semantic class occupying one slot, and splitting it would make six choices against the template's four. This is the doctrine's comma-list-welds rule, and the weld has never been wrong for me. || ITEM 6 is the long-choice test: إخبار الدفاع المدني بذلك وإعطاء هم أكبر قدر من المعلومات عن الحمولة من خلال الملصق المثبت على المركبة is eighteen tokens with an internal و, and it welds, because all four choices are maṣdar-headed (إخبار / البقاء / محاولة / طمأنة) and a و-initial chunk would break that frame. The و is not a reason to cut, ever. || ITEM 17 reads as five choices (عشرة ركاب / عشرون راكب / ثلاثون راكبا / اربعون راكبا / خمسون راكبا) with the stem ending on the preposition عن. The alternative — folding عشرة ركاب into the stem — leaves a question with no correct answer, since 'more than ten passengers' is the actual bus definition and must be on the list. || ITEMS 15 and 20 show the meta-choice mid-list: أي من هذه appears in slot 3 of item 15 and أي من هذه المركبات in slot 2 of item 20, both marked medium since each abuts another النقط-less choice (أقرب ما يمكن الى الخطوط; المركبات المتجهة الى الأمام). Their neighbouring boundaries are unaffected. || ITEMS 3 and 4 are true/false and follow the recorded gold [statement] || صح || خطأ exactly: the whole statement, including its subordinate clauses and the number 6, is one segment, then each verdict word is its own. || 92 boundaries, mean segment 5.6 tokens — short, but that is what a layout-driven MCQ bank is, and I explicitly did NOT import any prose-length prior into it.
